headline: Main thawed: stale pause probes fixed, green nightly in flight
lede: Three nightly suites went blind when the shared help overlay dropped its <h2> in the text-fit pass. QA shipped the one-line-per-suite probe fix (#1118); this lane independently root-caused it, proved all three suites green on the fixed main in real Chrome, and re-dispatched the nightly after the first retry died on a hung runner.

notes.text: Root cause of the #601 freeze: missileplay/paperplay/wizplay probed 'h2, [class*=pause]' — gone since #1108. The overlay itself never broke.
Local proof on bf4bf07: wizplay 25/25, paperplay 24/24, missileplay 25/25 with real key events.
A step at 3.7x its normal runtime with no logs is a hung runner, not a slow check — cancelled and re-dispatched (run 40373995858) instead of waiting out the job timeout.
Board is honestly empty: every flagship README gap (SSX, Emberwood, COMET DRIFT HD, Myst) is CLOSED or QA-owned; flagshipStage → null.
